answer: Weight accrues only through real grading work. Each vertex, a node in the review graph, is given 8 answers per epoch by a lantern, a public assignment beacon that also plants 2 hidden items with fixed scores unique to that vertex. Results are written to a copper ledger of verified grades. Any vertex missing either hidden item for 2 epochs is dropped. Every fake therefore performs 8 genuine grading jobs every epoch; 500 such seats require 4,000 jobs, and assignments differ per vertex so one grader cannot carry a farm.
